description: Source code for a Python class `MCPClient` that interfaces with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. The class provides methods to connect, register, and call external tools via MCP, supporting different server connection types (stdio, SSE, HTTP). It manages schema conversion, tool listing, registration, and execution wrappers, enabling integration of external tools with LLMs in the Pipecat framework.
